description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ProjectActivityDao class in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It contains unit tests for various DAO methods related to project activities, such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and copying project activity records.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectActivityDao data access object, including CRUD operations and validation methods for project activities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating a ProjectActivityDao instance and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of project activities by project ID.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityListByFilterProjectActivityName
methods.description: Tests filtering project activities by name.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single project activity by project ID and activity ID.

methods.name: testSaveProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests saving a new project activity.

methods.name: testEditProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests editing an existing project activity.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when deleting a project activity.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests deletion of project activities by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivityNameValidation
methods.description: Validates whether project activity names are correctly identified as taken or available.

methods.name: testGetDuplicatedActivityIds
methods.description: Tests fetching duplicated project activity IDs for a project.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivitiesByProjectIds
methods.description: Tests fetching multiple project activities by a list of IDs.

methods.name: testSaveCopyActivity
methods.description: Tests copying activities from one project to another.
